anchor: scored on provisioned GPU-time per hardware class (RTX~5090-class worker-seconds for the encoder pool, H100 GPU-hours for the language pool; never summed across classes).
claim_text: Scoring for provisioned GPU-time is done separately per hardware class: RTX 5090-class worker-seconds for the encoder pool and H100 GPU-hours for the language pool; values are never summed across classes.

anchor: Language-pool GPU-hours bill from instance order, not readiness
claim_text: Language-pool GPU-hours are billed from instance order, not readiness, integrating provisioned worker count including starting-up and draining instances.

anchor: encoder pool bills from readiness, its cold-start reported separately
claim_text: Encoder pool billing starts from readiness, with cold-start reported separately.

anchor: Each burst window brackets its episode with a $\pm$10-minute calm margin
claim_text: Each burst window includes a ±10-minute calm margin around its episode.

anchor: Scale-downs take effect immediately, guarded by a 3-minute hysteresis.
claim_text: Scale-downs take effect immediately with a 3-minute hysteresis guard.

anchor: every burst window forces the language pool to TP2, and the gain is the parallelism layout, not the GPU budget
claim_text: Every burst window requires the language pool to use TP2; the performance gain comes from parallelism layout, not increased GPU budget.

anchor: The reactive baseline is Dynamo's SLA planner... All fourteen configurations satisfy the planner's own control law while violating the tail SLA
claim_text: All 14 reactive configurations (Dynamo's SLA planner variants A and B) meet the planner's window-mean control law but violate the tail SLA (TTFT p99 up to 3,495 ms).

anchor: Holding a 60-second replica lead and tightening the planner's window-mean targets... raises GPU-hours monotonically (18.6→20.4) while TTFT p99 stays pinned near 1,616 ms
claim_text: Tightening mean targets with a 60-second lead increases GPU-hours (18.6→20.4) without reducing TTFT p99 (remains ~1,616 ms).

anchor: The deployable static fleet (C=8 encoders + TP2×2) overprovisions the calm day by 4× on vision and 2× on language
claim_text: The deployable static fleet (C=8 encoders + TP2×2) overprovisions the calm day by 4× on encoder side and 2× on language side.

anchor: reactive encoder control holds the bound for 0.687× the deployable fleet's worker-time
claim_text: Reactive encoder control achieves 0.687× the worker-time of the deployable fleet at aggregate scale.
